On Mon, 02 Sep 2002 20:48:43 -0400, Franz Foltz <faf...@rit.edu>
wrote:

>Very simple two part question thanks to the new Concealed Weapon card.
>If you have already answered these, sorry to bring them up again.

>Does Mass Reality affect Concealed Weapon's 3 damage limit?

No.
A "regular strike" doesn't count the damage added by Mass Reality, so
Concealed Weapon doesn't care whether or not there is a Mass Reality
in play.

LSJ 2002-08-21
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3D63D997.D1657D1F%40white-wolf.com

A "regular strike" is unmodified, so would use the default strength
value (of 1) for determining how much damage is done.

>Is Mass Reality stackable?

Yes.

All cards stack by default, specific card text is required to override
that.

LSJ 2001-11-23
